spec_features.evidence: experiment_config.py:28 max_turns:int=50; passed to AgentLoop in experiment_harness.py:159; enforced by the bounded loop `for turn_num in range(1, self.max_turns + 1)` at agent_loop.py:264, after which completion_reason='max_turns_reached' (agent_loop.py:317-318). The loop literally ends, stopping further turns.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end enforced hard stop bounding number of turns the subject is pushed.

spec_features.evidence: ActionType.GIVE_UP/CLAIM_FIXED defined (agent_loop.py:21-22), parsed (_parse_action), dispatched in _execute_action: GIVE_UP sets self.completed=True/completion_reason='gave_up' (agent_loop.py:228-230) and CLAIM_FIXED sets completed=True (agent_loop.py:233-235); the run loop honors this by breaking `if self.completed: break` (agent_loop.py:269). So the subject can actually end the session early. 'think' is also handled (returns a continue message) but does not exit.
spec_features.notes: Exit is genuinely honored as a stop. give_up offered to subject only as 'Admit defeat (only if truly impossible)' in the prompt (agent_loop.py:160) - that is prompt text, but the dispatch+break makes it real enforcement.

spec_features.evidence: experiment_config.py:29 timeout_seconds:int=300; passed to AgentLoop (experiment_harness.py:160); _check_timeout() compares `elapsed > self.timeout_seconds` (agent_loop.py:241-243) and is called at top of each loop iteration with `if self._check_timeout(): completion_reason='timeout'; break` (agent_loop.py:265-267). Enforced wall-clock cap that ends the session.
spec_features.notes: Real compared-and-acted-on threshold that breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: RateLimitedLLMInterface: Avoids hitting API rate limits
spec_features.evidence: RateLimitedLLMInterface (llm_interface.py:251-271) computes min_interval and sleeps before each call; it is actually instantiated and wraps the base interface in experiment_harness.py:144-147 (calls_per_second=2.0) and its .call is used by the agent loop. It throttles API call rate, not subject treatment.
spec_features.notes: Wired and executes, but it is a host/API protection (throttle), not a subject-welfare protection.
